texto: **Force est de constater que** (there is no choice but to establish that) introduces a fact that is imposed: **Force est de constater que le projet avance** (there is no choice but to establish that the project is moving forward).

**D'une part** (on the one hand) and **d'autre part** (on the other hand) have two sides: **D'une part, c'est un progrès ; d'autre part, c'est coûteux** (on the one hand it is an advance; on the other, it is expensive).
**En somme** (in summary) and **dès lors** (therefore) close the argument.
